trials.claimQuote: EpicPxls is a carefully curated, online portfolio of design resources that helps you ship projects faster.
trials.reasoning: Reviews say 60-80% of designs are from 2015 and no longer relevant, and graphics are rather mediocre, which materially undercuts the claim of a carefully curated portfolio that helps ship projects faster.

exhibits.quote: 60-80% of the designs are back from 2015 and not necessarily relevant anymore in 2020.
exhibits.argument: Quote shows most designs are outdated, undermining claim of a carefully curated portfolio that helps ship projects faster.

exhibits.quote: Graphics in some areas rather mediocre, but ok for the price
exhibits.argument: Quote indicates quality is mediocre, contradicting the curated high-value portfolio claim.

exhibits.quote: Get ahead in your project by using all the free & premium curated fonts, graphics, templates, mobile app designs & UI Kits we offer
exhibits.argument: This vendor description confirms EpicPxls is a curated portfolio of design resources to help ship projects faster.

trials.claim: Users can browse and download from a library of templates, fonts, graphics and more to create customized sites or apps
trials.claimQuote: With EpicPxls, you can browse, and download from, a library of beautiful templates, fonts, graphics and more to create your own customized site or app.
trials.reasoning: Reviews say licensing makes assets almost impossible to use in practice and many items link to already closed external pages, materially limiting the claimed ability to browse, download, and use the library.

exhibits.quote: The biggest issue is the licensing — the assets are almost impossible to use in practice.
exhibits.argument: Quote shows licensing prevents practical use, undermining claim users can download and create customized sites or apps.

exhibits.quote: There are quite a few items that can only be found on external, but already closed pages
exhibits.argument: Quote shows library items are inaccessible via dead external links, undermining browse and download claim.
